Exercise: Hip Circles (prone)

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- circular_motion

Primary Muscles:

- abductors

Secondary Muscles:

- adductors

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
3

Energy Requirement:
low to moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:
None

Contraindications:

- condition: recent hip surgery, reason: may cause discomfort or strain
- condition: severe hip joint issues, reason: could exacerbate existing conditions

Exercise Variations:

- name: Hip Circles (supine), force: pull, level: beginner, mechanic: isolation, primaryMuscles: ['abductors'], secondaryMuscles: ['adductors']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Leg Swings (forward), equipment: body only
- exercise_name: Leg Swings (backward), equipment: body only

Instructions:

- Position yourself on your hands and knees on the ground. Maintaining good posture, raise one bent knee off of the ground. This will be your starting position.
- Keeping the knee in a bent position, rotate the femur in an arc, attempting to make a big circle with your knee.
- Perform this slowly for a number of repetitions, and repeat on the other side.
